alternatives: To know yourself is difficult.

items.text: It takes one hour for me to get here.

items.text: It is rude of you to do so.
alternatives: It is rude of you to do that.

items.text: It is very kind of you to help me.
alternatives: It's really kind of you to help me.
It is so kind of you to help me.

items.text: It is cruel of him to desert his old father.

items.text: It is foolish of you to believe him.
alternatives: It is stupid of you to believe him.

items.text: It is very wise of him to study English grammar first.
alternatives: It is really wise of him to study English grammar first.

items.text: It's so thoughtful of you to prepare dinner for us tonight.
alternatives: It's very thoughtful of you to prepare dinner for us tonight.
